data.name: Marco Polo
data.detailed_description:
Marco Polo is a 2D couch co-op puzzle game in which two dots work together to figure out how to solve various problems in the world they inhabit. Sit down with your favorite person and explore the world with Marco & Polo! See their bond develop as you navigate a series of intuitive co-op puzzles, reflecting on the highs, lows, tribulations, and complexities of relationships.

In a world of ordinary grey dots, Marco and Polo happen to be the only two extraordinarily colorful dots in existence. From the moment they were created, Marco and Polo have always had an incredible attraction and bond towards one another. Perhaps it was their one-of-a-kind qualities that drew them together. Despite not really understanding this insatiable force to its full extent, Marco and Polo have always cherished every moment they spend together, until they start growing up and it turns out their friendship isn’t perfect, but still good. The story of Marco Polo follows these two characters as they navigate the tribulations of their relationship, experienced through an anthology of letters and fragments of memories. Will they drift apart, or will their bond become stronger than ever?   

Each level of Marco Polo contains a unique hidden action that the player has to perform. Your goal is incredibly simple: figure out what you're supposed to do! Use the Left Joystick, WASD, or Arrow Keys to move around, and work together with your partner to unlock new chapters to the story of Marco & Polo.

Themed Level Packs

Unlock new exciting adventures as you play! Each level pack contains about 7-10 levels, perfect for a short casual play session! You can pause the game and come back at any time to pick up right where you left off. Prepare yourself for harder challenges as you progress through each level pack! 

Online Multiplayer

Worried about your soulmate being far apart? Rest assured, we'll get you guys in the same lobby through our online multiplayer system.

Customizable Characters

If blue and orange aren't your cup of tea, you can always swap out for another color scheme!
